name: lv24-vigil

tools.name: vigil_scan
tools.description: Run Vigil's deterministic security rules over a repository or directory, optionally with model triage, deep review and a threat model. Returns a text summary and the windowed scan result (page and coverage blocks) as structuredContent. Results are windowed: maxFindings is the page size (default 50, capped at 500) and offset selects the page; the page object states offset, limit, total, hasMore and nextOffset, and a coverage object states what was scanned, skipped and whether a model was used. Writes local scan history, never source files. Scanned code is treated as data, never executed.

baseRef.description: Git ref to diff against when changedOnly is set (default HEAD).

changedOnly.description: Scan only files changed against baseRef (requires a git repository).

deepReview.description: Run the LLM deep review over high-risk files (requires a model).

diff.description: Unified diff to scan instead of the working tree. Overrides changedOnly.

exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude in addition to the project defaults.

include.description: Glob patterns to include in addition to the project defaults.

maxFindings.description: Page size: maximum findings in this window (default 50, capped at 500).

mode.description: Scan depth. All modes run the deterministic rules; quick is the fastest LLM budget, standard is the default, deep adds an LLM deep review when a model is configured.

noBaseline.description: Ignore the baseline and report suppressed findings as active.

offset.description: Zero-based finding offset for paging. Start with 0, then pass page.nextOffset from the previous result.

onlyRules.description: Run only these rule IDs (for example VGL-SEC-001).

path.description: Directory or repository to scan. Defaults to the server's project root.

threatModel.description: Also generate an LLM threat model and attach it to the result (requires a model).

useLlm.description: Use the configured model. Omit to use the server default; false forces deterministic rules only.

tools.name: vigil_review
tools.description: Scan only the added lines of a diff: the working-tree changes against a git ref, or a unified diff supplied by the client. Returns a text summary and the windowed scan result. Results are windowed: maxFindings is the page size (default 50, capped at 500) and offset selects the page; the page object states total, hasMore and nextOffset, and a coverage object states what was scanned and whether a model was used. Writes local scan history, never source files.

baseRef.description: Git ref to diff against (default HEAD).

changedOnly.description: Review only changed files. Defaults to true; ignored when diff is supplied.

diff.description: Unified diff to review. When omitted, changed files are read from git.

maxFindings.description: Page size: maximum findings in this window (default 50, capped at 500).

offset.description: Zero-based finding offset for paging. Start with 0, then pass page.nextOffset from the previous result.

path.description: Directory or repository to review. Defaults to the server's project root.

useLlm.description: Use the configured model for triage. Omit to use the server default.

tools.name: vigil_dependencies
tools.description: Read dependency manifests and lockfiles, query the public OSV.dev database for the exact versions found and report known public advisories. Returns a text summary and the inventory, findings, coverage errors and limitations as structuredContent. Read-only: no package manager runs, no writes and no telemetry. Unavailable on a server started in offline mode: the call is refused with VGL-OFFLINE instead of returning an empty audit.

includeDev.description: Also query dev dependencies. Defaults to true.

maxPackages.description: Maximum distinct packages to query (default 200, capped at 1000).

osvBaseUrl.description: Override the OSV API root. Defaults to https://api.osv.dev; must be https, or http on a loopback host (127.0.0.1, ::1, localhost). Credentials in the URL are refused.

path.description: Directory or repository to audit. Defaults to the server's project root.

tools.name: vigil_hardening
tools.description: Run only the anti-RE hardening rules (VGL-ARE-*): release minification, debug signing, debuggable builds, backup and cleartext settings, plist transport exceptions, release obfuscation, Electron/Node isolation, inspector flags and production source maps. Reports hardening gaps, not vulnerabilities. Optionally narrow the review to one platform. Results are windowed: maxFindings is the page size (default 50, capped at 500) and offset selects the page; the page object states total, hasMore and nextOffset, and a coverage object states what was scanned. Returns a text summary grouped by platform and the scan result as structuredContent. Writes local scan history, never source files.

maxFindings.description: Page size: maximum findings in this window (default 50, capped at 500).

noBaseline.description: Ignore the baseline and report suppressed findings as active.

offset.description: Zero-based finding offset for paging. Start with 0, then pass page.nextOffset from the previous result.

path.description: Mobile or desktop project to review. Defaults to the server's project root.

platform.description: Only report findings for this platform. Defaults to all.

tools.name: vigil_mcp_audit
tools.description: Run only the MCP configuration rules (VGL-MCP-*): unpinned server packages, literal secrets in env/headers/args, cleartext remote endpoints, disabled TLS verification, dangerous mounts, auto-approval and prompt-injection surfaces. Reads .mcp.json, mcp.json, mcp-config.json, claude_desktop_config.json, opencode.json[c], *.mcp.json and YAML variants; with includeUser it also reads known home-directory configs. Deterministic and offline: no configured server is started, no endpoint is contacted and nothing is written. Results are windowed: maxFindings is the page size (default 50, capped at 500) and offset selects the page; the page object states total, hasMore and nextOffset, and a coverage object states what was read. Returns a text summary and the audit result as structuredContent.

includeUser.description: Also read known user-level MCP configs under the home directory.

maxFindings.description: Page size: maximum findings in this window (default 50, capped at 500).

offset.description: Zero-based finding offset for paging. Start with 0, then pass page.nextOffset from the previous result.

path.description: Directory to audit. Defaults to the server's project root; the resolved path must stay inside it.

tools.name: vigil_explain
tools.description: Explain one finding: what the rule detected, why it matters, an exploit scenario and the remediation direction. Uses the configured model when available; otherwise returns the deterministic rule description and remediation.

findingId.description: Finding ID (VGL-...), fingerprint (fp_...) or a unique prefix.

line.description: Line number within path. Omit to match the only finding on that path.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the finding; use with line instead of findingId.

scanId.description: Scan to look in. Defaults to the most recent scan.

tools.name: vigil_fix
tools.description: Propose a validated unified diff for one finding, then apply exactly that diff after a human reviewed it. mode=propose (the default) writes no source files; it stores a local proposal and returns fixId, diffSha256 and expiresAt. mode=apply requires those values, verifies every target file is unchanged and applies the stored diff to the working tree; it never commits. apply=true is a deprecated alias for mode=apply and is unbound only when the server enables the unsafe escape hatch.

apply.description: Deprecated: true means mode=apply and still needs fixId and diffSha256. Defaults to false.

diffSha256.description: SHA-256 of the proposed diff. Required for mode=apply.

findingId.description: Finding ID (VGL-...), fingerprint (fp_...) or a unique prefix.

fixId.description: Proposal ID returned by mode=propose. Required for mode=apply.

line.description: Line number within path. Omit to match the only finding on that path.

mode.description: propose returns a diff and a fixId without writing; apply applies a reviewed proposal.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the finding; use with line instead of findingId.

scanId.description: Scan to look in. Defaults to the most recent scan.

tools.name: vigil_threat_model
tools.description: Ask the configured model for a repository threat model: assets, trust boundaries, entry points and the most likely attack paths. Requires a model.

path.description: Directory to model. Must match the server's project root; defaults to it.

tools.name: vigil_status
tools.description: Report the engine version, project root, model configuration (with the key redacted), rule count, categories, store directory, the effective read-only and offline modes, the network posture, the last scan summary and startup warnings.

tools.name: vigil_rules
tools.description: List the deterministic detection rules with their severity, category, languages and title. Optionally filter by category, language, severity or a free-text query. The result is windowed: limit is the page size (default 50, capped at 500) and offset selects the page; the page object states total, hasMore and nextOffset.

language.description: Only rules that apply to this language (for example go, python, javascript, yaml). Generic rules are included.

limit.description: Maximum rules in this window (default 50, capped at 500).

offset.description: Zero-based rule offset for paging. Start with 0, then pass page.nextOffset from the previous result.

query.description: Case-insensitive text matched against the ID, title, description, tags, CWE and OWASP fields.

severity.description: Only rules with this base severity.

tools.name: vigil_baseline
tools.description: List, add, remove, prune or clear accepted findings in the project baseline. Adding requires a finding ID and a reason; an acceptance can carry a ticket, an expiry date, a disposition, and the resolved finding's path and rule scope. dryRun previews the suppression impact without writing. Batch validates up to 50 add/remove items before writing, reports per-item misses and defaults to dryRun=true. Removed or expired entries stop suppressing on the next scan.

action.description: Baseline operation. Defaults to list. prune and batch default to dryRun=true.

confirm.description: Required for clear: confirm that the baseline is emptied.

disposition.description: Why the finding is accepted. A remediated finding must be removed from the baseline instead.

dryRun.description: Preview the change without writing. Defaults to true for batch and prune, false for add and remove.

expires.description: Expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). The entry stops suppressing the next day; a past date is rejected on add.

findingId.description: Finding ID (VGL-...), fingerprint (fp_...) or a unique prefix. Required for add and remove.

items.description: Batch of add/remove items (max 50). Requires action=batch. A write requires dryRun=false; any invalid item leaves the baseline untouched.

expires.description: Expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); a past date is rejected on add.

findingId.description: Finding ID, fingerprint or unique prefix.

reason.description: Why the finding is accepted. Required for add.

ticket.description: Ticket or issue reference (control characters stripped, 128 characters max).

limit.description: List: findings per page (default 50, capped at 500).

offset.description: List: number of findings to skip. Defaults to 0.

reason.description: Why the finding is accepted. Required for add.

scanId.description: Scan to resolve findings in and to preview the suppression impact. Defaults to the most recent scan.

ticket.description: Ticket or issue reference stored with the acceptance. Control characters are stripped and the value is capped at 128 characters.

tools.name: vigil_report
tools.description: Render a stored scan as Markdown, JSON, SARIF or HTML. Without path the report is returned as text; with path it is written inside the app root and the absolute path is returned.

path.description: Relative path inside the app root to write the report to (for example reports/vigil.md).

scanId.description: Scan to render. Defaults to the most recent scan.

tools.name: vigil_verify
tools.description: Re-scan the finding's file (or explicit paths) with the deterministic rules and report whether the same fingerprint is still present. Useful after a fix.

findingId.description: Finding ID (VGL-...), fingerprint (fp_...) or a unique prefix.

line.description: Line number within path. Omit to match the only finding on that path.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the finding; use with line instead of findingId.

paths.description: Files to re-scan, relative to the scan root. Defaults to the finding's file.

scanId.description: Scan the finding belongs to. Defaults to the most recent scan.

tools.name: vigil_history
tools.description: List stored scans, newest first, with their finding, critical and high counts. The response is windowed: limit is the page size (default 10, capped at 100) and offset selects the page; the page object states total, hasMore and nextOffset. Scan IDs can be passed to vigil_explain, vigil_fix, vigil_report and vigil_verify.

limit.description: Maximum number of scans in this window (default 10, capped at 100).

offset.description: Zero-based scan offset for paging. Start with 0, then pass page.nextOffset from the previous result.

instructions: Vigil audits the configured project for security issues. Tools are prefixed vigil_; write paths are confined to the server root. vigil_fix apply=true is bound to review: call it first with mode=propose (the default), show the returned diff to the user, then call mode=apply with the returned fixId and diffSha256.
